description: ZADFEU crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group P b c a. Reported CIF formula moiety: C43 H37 Dy2 N5 O15. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.507-3.507 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 95.92-99.40°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy2(ql)3(Xa)(NO3)2(CH3OH)2(H2O)] (Hql = 8-hydroxyquinoline; HXa = xanthene-9-carboxylic acid). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
